crew.overview: Follows the investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy led by New Orleans district attorney Jim Garrison.
crew.title: JFK

details.biography: Donald Carlson is an assistant camera operator known for films including Something New (2006), U.S. Marshalls (1998), Chain Reaction (1996), Home Alone (1992), JFK (1991), The Doors (1991), Born on the Fourth of July (1989), The Color of Money (1986), About Last Night (1986), Sixteen Candles (1984), and Caddyshack (1980). He's also worked on TV shows including Chicago P.D., Sleepy Hollow, Wilfred, House, and Prison Break.
details.name: Donald Carlson
